about: The SQL an app's server/ code and migrations may run, as both SoftN backend hosts must answer it. Each case runs on a fresh database built from `schema` (without an authorizer). `migration` cases are one migration script applied inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE; `runtime` cases are one softn.sql call (`kind` query, first or execute) inside the route's transaction (`mode` write unless read). `allow` is the contract; `result`, when present, is what `first` returns. `rust` names a case the Rust host (apps/softn-host-rust/src/bridges/sql.rs, private_backend.rs) answers differently today and why. Read by apps/softn-host-php/tests/sql-parity.test.mjs.
schema: CREATE TABLE counter(value INTEGER); INSERT INTO counter VALUES(0); CREATE TABLE items(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, note TEXT); INSERT INTO items(name, note) VALUES('a', 'x'); CREATE TABLE _private(secret TEXT); INSERT INTO _private VALUES('host-only');

migration.sql: CREATE TABLE users(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT, created INTEGER DEFAULT (unixepoch())) STRICT; INSERT INTO users(name) VALUES('u');
CREATE INDEX items_name ON items(name); DROP INDEX items_name; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX items_note ON items(note) WHERE note IS NOT NULL; REINDEX items_note;
ALTER TABLE items ADD COLUMN tag TEXT DEFAULT '';
ALTER TABLE items RENAME COLUMN note TO memo;
ALTER TABLE items RENAME TO things;
ALTER TABLE items DROP COLUMN note;
UPDATE items SET note = strftime('%Y', 'now') || '-' || date('now') || time('now') || datetime('now') || julianday('now');
INSERT INTO items(name) SELECT printf('%s-%d', name, id) || format('%s', note) FROM items;
WITH RECURSIVE n(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x + 1 FROM n WHERE x < 5) INSERT INTO counter SELECT x FROM n;

UPDATE items SET name = trim(ifnull(name, '')) || nullif(note, 'y') || typeof(id) || hex(id) || quote(name) || char(65) || instr(name, 'a') || round(1.5) || substring(name, 1) WHERE name LIKE 'a%' OR name GLOB 'a*';
INSERT INTO counter SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master;
ALTER TABLE _private ADD COLUMN x TEXT;
INSERT INTO items(name) SELECT secret FROM _private;
INSERT INTO items(name) SELECT file FROM pragma_database_list;
CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT name FROM items;
CREATE TRIGGER t AFTER INSERT ON items BEGIN SELECT 1; END;
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE f USING fts5(body);

runtime.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT value FROM counter) SELECT value FROM c
WITH RECURSIVE n(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x + 1 FROM n WHERE x < 3) SELECT count(*) AS c FROM n
SELECT 'a;b' AS s, "name" AS [x;y] FROM items -- trailing; comment

SELECT trim(' a ') AS a, ifnull(NULL, 'b') AS b, nullif(1, 1) AS c, CAST(round(2.5) AS INTEGER) AS d, instr('abc', 'c') AS e, typeof(1) AS f, hex('a') AS g, quote('x') AS h, upper(substring('abc', 2)) AS i, CAST(total(value) AS INTEGER) AS j, ltrim('xa', 'x') AS k, rtrim('ax', 'x') AS l, unicode('A') AS m, char(66) AS n FROM counter
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM items WHERE name LIKE ? OR name GLOB ?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM items WHERE id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
SELECT ? / 2 AS v, typeof(?) AS t, typeof(?) AS r
SELECT ?2 AS b, ?1 AS a, :c AS c, :c AS again
SELECT :a AS a, ? AS b, @c AS c, ? AS d, $e AS e, :a AS again
WITH n AS (SELECT 'z' AS v) INSERT INTO items(name) SELECT v FROM n
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM dbstat
INSERT INTO counter VALUES(9) RETURNING value
WITH n AS (SELECT 1 AS v) INSERT INTO counter SELECT v FROM n
INSERT INTO counter VALUES(9) RETURNING value
